verdict.rationale: Square's docs explicitly document Tap to Pay on iPhone for contactless card, Apple Pay, and other digital wallet acceptance in person, plus Terminal API and hardware for chip/contactless/tip processing on dedicated hardware. Community commentary corroborates the core payment-processing capability as strong, with only unrelated pricing/security tangents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of chip-card acceptance specifically and Google Pay parity confirmation beyond doc mentions.
